note: Verification certificate for a published worked example of the fractionated Morse cipher (Practical Cryptography). The page prints defend the east in lowercase; the recovered plaintext is DEFEND THE EAST, with the word spaces kept. Known-cipher solver only. Not an unknown-script reading. Not a reading of Linear A, Indus, Voynich, rongorongo, Kryptos K4, or army message Nr. 86.
